metazoa.definition:
n multicellular animals having cells differentiated into tissues and organs and usually a digestive cavity and nervous system
n any animal of the subkingdom Metazoa; all animals except protozoans and sponges
metazoa.translation: n. [动]复细胞动物,后生动物

metazoal.translation:
n. [动]后生动物, 多细胞动物
a. 后生动物的, 多细胞动物的

metazoan.definition: n. any animal of the subkingdom Metazoa; all animals except protozoans and sponges
metazoan.translation:
n. 后生动物
a. 后生动物的

metazoans.translation:
a. 后生动物的；多细胞动物的
n. 后生动物；多细胞动物

metazoic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the Metazoa.
metazoic.translation:
n. [动]后生动物, 多细胞动物
a. 后生动物的, 多细胞动物的

metazonal.translation: [医] 巩带后的, 巩带下的

metazoon.translation: [医] 后生动物(有时指复细胞动物)
